structured_output.world_model:
W2 (empirical), after E060. Tip E060: 5.178 s, 0.7533 (seeds 0-2). Same-commit rebuilds give 3-seed means that move about 0.1-0.3 pp (E036: 0.7497-0.7544; E049/E050/E057: 0.7535/0.7552/0.7536). Time moves about 0.03 s per rebuild.

Mechanisms, each tied to its experiments:
1. Epoch dial: about 1.5-2 s/pp. Each step of about 0.25 epoch costs about 2.5% of time for 0-0.15 pp (E020, E023, E027, E049, E059). E059 (E046 vs E049) is inside the noise.
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon (+0.66 pp, confounded, E006) are in the tip. More than 10 time-neutral boosters came out flat or negative (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd and LS changes). I expect further tweaks to land within ±0.15 pp of zero.
3. Time tracks pixels and steps. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Removing steps or samples costs about the dial's rate (E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049). Freezing the stem before about 75% loses (E037, E054, E055). Group 2 tolerates a freeze from 85-90%. The whitening detach at 6% (E060) was neutral in accuracy and saved little time (5.198 → 5.178 s).
5. Activation or architecture cuts cost accuracy at the dial's rate or worse (E010, E021, E051, E056). E056 is ReLU: −0.25 s and −0.5 pp.
6. Non-step overhead is about 2.5% (E047), so pure systems work saves at most about 1%.
7. Noise: the population mean is about 0.752-0.7535, so headroom over the 0.75 bar is about 0.2 pp. Seed sets used for keeps carry a winner's curse of 0.1-0.2 pp.

Misses: I over-predicted time when variants cut work (E052, E056). I under-predicted accuracy on E053. Most recent changes are neutral at the 3-seed level.

Unsure:
- The rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean (I guess 0.08 pp).
- Whether Muon beats SGD on CIFAR-100 here (PR #3 says no).
- Whether tanh-GELU gives a real time saving.
- Whether the PCIe judge's build matches the local one.

forecasts.reason: Removing 12 early steps costs about the dial's rate (E041). Time falls about 0.1 s and accuracy about 0.1 pp, within noise.
Dropping Newton-Schulz saves only about 0.2 s. SGD may lose accuracy, since Muon's gain was confounded. Wide uncertainty.
Step 1 is a profile only. Tanh-GELU probably saves under 1.5%, so step 2 probably does not run and the tip's numbers carry over.
Fewer early steps are worth about the dial's rate (E041, E045). Time gain is small, about 1%, with a likely small accuracy loss.

cruxes: What is the true rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean? Every sub-0.15 pp keep decision depends on it.
Does SGD on the conv filters lose more than 0.25 pp against Muon at batch 2000? Muon's gain was confounded.
Does any activation cheaper than exact GELU (tanh-GELU, SiLU) save at least 1.5% without an accuracy loss?
